title: strychnos angolensis var. lacourtiana
intro: Strychnos angolensis var. lacourtiana, commonly known as the African seed box, is a plant species in the Loganiaceae family. It is a woody climber native to tropical Africa, and has been used in traditional medicine to treat various health conditions. The health benefits of this plant include its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which can help in wound healing, pain relief, and fever reduction. The bioactive constituents of Strychnos angolensis var. lacourtiana include alkaloids, flavonoids, and phenolic compounds, which contribute to its therapeutic actions such as anti-inflammatory and antiseptic effects.
